messages:
marta: Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands Q&A about reviews and comp — dropping clarifications here. If you asked live, I9ll tag you.

lee: Thanks! Two quick things: 1) promo effective dates and payroll alignment; 2) parental leave - how does that show in calibration notes?

marta: Short answers: 1) We aim for 1st-of-month effective dates for consistency. If a promo is approved mid-cycle, HR runs a retrocalc and payroll applies retro pay on next payroll.

owen: If a manager wants an off-cycle promo for retention, what extra approvals are needed?

marta: Off-cycle promos need clear impact summary + 2 manager reviews + People Ops sign-off. Finance reviews any retro pay. Use the off-cycle packet form (link posted below).

tasha: For parental leave, are managers expected to adjust goals or note missed stretch goals in the packet?

marta: Yes0— include a short "leave context" block with dates and notes. We explicitly exclude approved leave from negative scoring; highlight post-leave outcomes.

hr-bot: Link posted: https://redwood.internal/hr/reviews/spring-2026 (internal only) :link:

marta: I'll post anonymized promotion rates by level within 48 hours (no PII). Also scheduling a 30-min manager office hour tomorrow 15:00 PT to walk through packets. Ping me if timing conflicts.

lee: Appreciate it. Can we get the off-cycle template now?

hr-bot: Off-cycle template posted: https://redwood.internal/hr/offcycle-template :lock:

marta: Thanks all 44b feel free to drop follow-ups here and I9ll consolidate for managers.
